mapping.summary: Drag-and-drop production scheduling board that writes operation dates back to BC.
claims: Board offers a weekly day grid, a Gantt chart and a full-year capacity overview
Released production orders land in an unplanned backlog for the planner
Dragging an operation to a work center and day commits the schedule to BC immediately
Moving an operation updates its schedule status and start date and time in BC
Work center capacity per day is derived from operator rosters, absences and breaks
Shop calendar holidays close the day and show the reason
Backlog can be searched by order, item or description and filtered by work center and due window
Overdue work is flagged in the backlog
Order lines, operations, BOM, drawings and shop floor activity log are viewable from the board
Each planner keeps their own saved filters and default view
Execution status from uShopfloor flows back onto the planning board
No separate planning database; BC stays the system of record
Needs the uTools Base Application and a uTools subscription
